Xi Jinping, then Party secretary of Zhejiang province, recognized the mismatch. He compared Yiwu to a fast-growing child needing clothes that fit, and promoted reforms to expand its administrative powers. Yiwu's transformation shows that, when facing development challenges, a correct view of governance performance — following the objective laws and embracing reform and innovation — can create new opportunities.
